title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem ao ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em Java e outras linguagens de programação. (experiência mínima de 4 anos )
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Habilidade para identificar e solucionar desafios técnicos de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;
  • Noções de banco de dados PostgreSQL e Mongo;
  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;
  • Busca constante por melhorias nos sistemas e processos existentes.
  • Capacidade de documentar código e comunicar ideias técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas: Busca contínua por aprendizado e soluções eficazes. Capacidade de colaborar em equipe, receber feedback construtivo e contribuir para o sucesso do projeto


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com sistemas legados desenvolvidos a partir do Java 8;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação Node, Typescript, React e Angular;
  • Familiaridade e experiência com o uso de Docker para implantação e gestão de contêineres;
  • Experiência prévia com aplicativos de gerenciamento de caches e/ou sistemas de filas de eventos.



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior para atuar na mina subterrânea , sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico e gestão do sistema de ventilação , bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
  • Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
  • Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
  • Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
  • Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).


Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:


  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues


Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)


Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

This role involves supporting a large and diverse user base, evolving the mobile application with new features, and ensuring high performance and quality across devices.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to plan, design, and deliver new application features.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.

Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans.   • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
description:
Salary: 55 LPA INR


Position Overview – Senior iOS Engineer

We are seeking experienced iOS engineers who enjoy working closely with cross‑functional teams and who bring strong architectural thinking, product sensibility, and a deep understanding of modern iOS development.

This role involves supporting a large and diverse user base, evolving the mobile application with new features, and ensuring high performance and quality across devices.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to plan, design, and deliver new application features.
  • Work together with backend/API developers and other mobile engineers to maintain a scalable, reliable, and well‑structured app ecosystem.
  • Continuously explore new iOS technologies and propose improvements to enhance product quality and user experience.
  • Participate in code reviews, refine development processes, and contribute to technical decision‑making.
  • Improve workflows, documentation, and collaboration practices within the engineering team.
  • Stay current with iOS platform changes and apply best practices to ongoing development.

Mandatory Requirements

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of iOS development experience using Swift .
  • Minimum 1 year of hands‑on development using SwiftUI .
  • Deep understanding of modern iOS features and platform best practices.
  • Experience working with mid‑complexity mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM , VIPER , Clean Architecture , etc.).
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD platforms such as Bitrise or Jenkins.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles (e.g., SOLID , design patterns).
  • Familiarity with automated mobile testing (Unit, UI, Smoke Testing, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Motivated to work in a team‑based product environment.
  • Strong sense of UX, attention to detail, and focus on usability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reactive programming frameworks.
  • Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD).
  • Knowledge of performance profiling, debugging, and optimization on iOS.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and guidelines.
  • Experience in travel‑related products or services.

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.


You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.


You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Must Haves

  • 1+ year of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python or Java development experience, including API development, model training, testing, and general backend engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ingestion workflows, or ETL processes
  • Experience evaluating the quality of Search or Generative AI systems
  • Strong communication skills; able to work independently while providing clear, consistent updates to the team
  • Collaborative team player who is proactive in sharing knowledge and contributing to team best practices

Plusses

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience using LangChain to build LLM workflows with tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other Lucene-based search technologies
  • Experience with Airflow
  • Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures


Day to Day

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Responsibilities span the full lifecycle, including content ingestion and pipeline development, indexing and retrieval quality improvements, answer generation, and system evaluation. You will work on experimentation, model development, ETL workflows, search relevance, and evaluation frameworks. The role includes deploying code to non-production environments and supporting production releases in collaboration with the DevOps team. This is primarily a hands-on individual contributor role, with an expectation of clear communication, collaboration, and active participation in team discussions and planning.

description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;

  • TotalPass.

  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA (Generative AI & Agentic Systems)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .



O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica
